# OhMy

> The landing page and portal for the OhMy suite: local-first, browser-only tools
> for students and professionals. No account required, no backend.

OhMy is a family of focused productivity tools. Every product runs entirely in
the browser (or with a small optional server for OAuth) and stores its data
locally — no sign-up, no upload of your work to a third party.

## Products

- **OhMyDocs** (https://docs.ohmy.lat): local-first document editor with
  editorial-grade output, block composition, Markdown round-trip and custom
  branding profiles.
- **OhMyMail** (https://mail.ohmy.lat): email template composer. Markdown in,
  branded HTML out.
- **OhMyGrid** (https://grid.ohmy.lat): visual bento-grid designer. Exports
  React TSX or standalone HTML.
- **OhMyForms** (https://forms.ohmy.lat): browser-only form builder with a
  drag-and-drop editor and per-form response tables.
- **OhMyCharts** (https://charts.ohmy.lat): Scrum burndown calculator with four
  input modes.
- **OhMyGantt** (https://gantt.ohmy.lat): Gantt timelines from GitHub Projects
  v2, Trello boards or manual task lists.
- **OhMyDiagrams** (https://diagrams.ohmy.lat): visual UML 2.5 use-case diagram
  editor with a validation checklist evaluated live on the canvas.
